_comment: The pinned commit of each private corpus the accuracy record is measured on. The runner (devmap-analyze/tests/real_corpus_accuracy.rs) reads DEVMAP_CORPUS_<NAME>=<checkout> and refuses any other commit or a dirty tree. Only the commit and the languages are committed: no paths, lines or symbol names from a private repository belong here or in record.json.
_comment_floors: recall_floors_percent: the E3 baseline (the 2026-10-09 audit measurement minus two points), held as a no-regression ratchet against the previous record row. recall_targets_percent: what each language card claims, gated absolutely - below target or unmeasured fails. A floor rises only in the change that measures it; neither may be lowered (no_recall_floor_or_card_target_is_ever_lowered).
_comment_must_include: A record row counts only when measured by a DevMap that contains every commit below: S2 (bare-name rung only with no other evidence, AmbiguousGlobal ledger-only) and the merge of each language lane. The runner refuses to run otherwise and stamps the list into each measurement as includes_commits; a row without it is reported stale in record.json open_gates.

record_must_include.what: S2 resolver: bare-name rung only with no other evidence, AmbiguousGlobal ledger-only
